question: Public audio recordings of speech or voice from people with Parkinson's disease and healthy controls, for deep learning detection

requirements.text: Actual audio files (wav etc.), not precomputed features
Both PD patients and healthy controls, labelled
Downloadable now without a lengthy approval

record.title: VOC-PD Dataset: Multi-task Mandarin Speech Recordings of Parkinson's Disease Patients and Healthy Controls
record.description: Overview The VOC-PD dataset is a Mandarin speech corpus specifically constructed to provide objective voice biomarkers for the diagnosis of Parkinson's Disease (PD). It comprises high-quality audio recordings from both Parkinson's Disease patients and Healthy Controls (HC). record.title: Arabic Parkinson's Disease Speech Dataset
record.description: This dataset contains audio recordings collected to investigate acoustic biomarkers and machine learning models for detecting Parkinson’s Disease (PD) in native Arabic speakers. Designed to support voice pathology detection, acoustic feature extraction, and cross-linguistic validation studies, it serves as a benchmark resource for speech processing and clinical AI applications. Participant Breakdown : 40 native Arabic-speaking subjects, comprising 17 diagnosed Parkinson’s Disease patients and 23 age-matched Healthy Controls (HC). Speech Tasks: Includes sustained vowel phonations (/a/, /i/, /u/), reading of a standardized phonetically balanced Arabic text passage, and spontaneous speech reco…

record.title: NeuroVoz: a Castillian Spanish corpus of parkinsonian speech
record.description: The NeuroVoz dataset emerges as a pioneering resource in the field of computational linguistics and biomedical research, specifically designed to enhance the diagnosis and understanding of Parkinson's Disease (PD) through speech analysis. This dataset is distinguished as the first of its kind to be made publicly available in Castilian Spanish, addressing a critical gap in the availability of linguistic and dialectical diversity within PD research. Compiled from a cohort of 112 participants, including 54 individuals diagnosed with PD and 58 healthy controls, the NeuroVoz dataset offers a rich compilation of speech recordings. record.title: Processed Multimodal MRI and Speech Datasets for Parkinson's Disease Classification
record.description: This repository contains the processed multimodal datasets and associated research materials supporting the study “ParkMultiNet combines MRI and speech data for multimodal Parkinson’s disease classification.” The deposit includes two datasets. PubPDdataset was constructed by integrating processed structural brain MRI scans from multiple publicly available repositories with publicly available speech data. It contains MRI data from 127 subjects (76 with Parkinson’s disease and 51 non-PD controls) and 502 processed speech clips (266 PD and 236 non-PD).
